subject: Dashbooard Package Error on Shiny Server

messages.author: d48c25039d976859
messages.subject: Dashbooard Package Error on Shiny Server
parts:
I am running the open source edition of Shiny server so I am running Ubuntu. I’ve noticed when I have shiny apps that require specific libraries to run, as long as I install the specific libraries command line

sudo su - \
-c "R -e \"install.packages('specific library name', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""

the app works. When I try to install using R Studio it doesn’t. I am wanting to run shiny dashboard and have installed shinydashboard and shinysignals through R Studio and my dashboard app won’t run. They show up in the list of installed packages in R Studio but the dashboard returns several errors that are related to not being able to find the packages. The app runs fine on my Windows machine so I know it isn’t the Shiny code. Is there a command line similar to above that will allow me to get apps from Github?
 
Thanks,

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Dashbooard Package Error on Shiny Server
parts: You could run the same 'sudo' command, but replace `install.packages(...)` with `install_github(...)`.
